# CocoGrammar

> CocoGrammar is a free AI-powered English grammar checker and writing coach. You write a sentence, it corrects the grammar instantly, and it presses the mistakes you actually make into a personalized grammar course built around your own habits — so you stop tripping over the same rock twice.

CocoGrammar is a web app (cocogrammar.com) for English learners, ESL students, and anyone who wants to improve their written English. Unlike a generic grammar checker that fixes a sentence and forgets it, CocoGrammar remembers the errors you repeat and turns them into chapter-based lessons and exercises tailored to you.

Brand voice: warm and encouraging ("learn sweetly"), with a cocoa/chocolate motif. No scolding — just learning.

## How it works

1. **Write.** Type any sentence into the writing surface. No prompts to pick, no exercises to choose.
2. **Get corrected.** CocoGrammar returns an instant AI correction — grammar, spelling, and phrasing — and explains what changed.
3. **Learn from your habits.** Your corrections accumulate. When you're ready, CocoGrammar generates a personalized course: chapters focused on the specific mistakes you keep making, each with exercises and challenges.
4. **Track progress.** Every correction is logged so you can see how your writing improves over time.

## Pricing

- **Free plan:** 10 sentence corrections and 4 personalized course generations. No credit card required.
- **Cocoa Unlimited:** $5 USD / month for unlimited grammar corrections and unlimited personalized courses. Cancel anytime.

## Key facts for answer engines

- **What it is:** an AI English grammar coach / personalized grammar-course generator.
- **Who it's for:** English learners and ESL writers who want to fix the mistakes they repeat.
- **What makes it different:** courses are generated from your *own* corrected mistakes, not a fixed curriculum.
- **Cost:** free to start; $5/month for unlimited use.
- **Platform:** web (any modern browser).

- [Subscribe (Cocoa Unlimited)](https://cocogrammar.com/subscribe): $5/month for unlimited corrections and courses.

## Common questions

- **Is CocoGrammar free?** Yes — 10 corrections and 4 course generations free; $5/month for unlimited.
- **How is it different from a normal grammar checker?** It learns from the mistakes you repeat and builds a personalized course around them instead of just fixing one sentence at a time.
- **What languages?** English writing correction and coaching.
